skills.name: airwallex-ai-provider-card-mit
skills.description: Use this skill to guide an end-to-end implementation plan document for card-only Airwallex Payments flows used by AI providers that self-manage subscriptions, token balances, manual top-ups, and auto-recharge with merchant-initiated transactions. Covers Web JS SDK Split Card Elements, card binding, billing information collection, fraud-data checks, scheduled MIT consent for subscriptions, unscheduled MIT consent for recharge, webhooks, and merchant-owned ledger, invoice, receipt, retry, notification, and cancellation logic. Do not use for non-card methods, customer-initiated one-click checkout, hosted checkout, Drop-in, HPP, or provider-managed subscription products.
headings: Airwallex Card MIT For AI Providers
No Embedded Code Examples In The Skill
skills.description_zh: 为自行管理订阅、令牌余额、手动充值及自动充值的 AI 服务商，编写仅银行卡 Airwallex Payments 商户发起交易的端到端实施方案。涵盖 Split Card Elements、绑卡、账单信息、欺诈数据、订阅定期及充值非定期 MIT 同意、webhook，以及商户自管台账、发票、收据、重试、通知和取消。不用于非卡支付、客户发起一键付款、托管结账、Drop-in、HPP 或服务商托管订阅产品。

skills.name: airwallex-billing-checkout
skills.description: Guide integration of Airwallex Billing Hosted Checkout for subscription, one-off payment (PAYMENT), and card-saving (SETUP) scenarios. Covers authentication, product/price creation, free trial, coupons, success page, webhooks, troubleshooting, and API version via .env. Use when user mentions billing checkout, subscription integration, recurring billing, free trial, coupon, promo code, billing_checkouts API, hosted billing page, 订阅, 周期扣款, 优惠券. Do NOT use for HPP / Hosted Payment Page / PaymentIntent; those belong to Online Payments, not Billing.
headings: Fallback (when Billing Checkout isn't the right fit)
skills.description_zh: 指导 Airwallex Billing Hosted Checkout 的订阅、一次性 PAYMENT 和存卡 SETUP 集成，涵盖认证、产品价格、试用、优惠券、成功页、webhook、排障及 .env API 版本。不用于属于 Online Payments 的 HPP、Hosted Payment Page 或 PaymentIntent。

skills.name: airwallex-dropin
skills.description: Generate Airwallex Drop-in Element integration code. Use when user mentions Drop-in, dropIn element, embedded payment UI, createElement('dropIn'), multi-method checkout, Apple Pay, Google Pay, 嵌入式支付, 多支付方式. Do NOT use for redirect-based HPP or single card-only Split Card flows.
skills.description_zh: 生成 Airwallex Drop-in Element 嵌入式多支付方式 UI 集成代码，含 Apple Pay 和 Google Pay；不用于跳转式 HPP 或仅银行卡的 Split Card。

skills.name: airwallex-hpp
skills.description: Generate Airwallex Hosted Payment Page (HPP) integration code. Use when user mentions HPP, hosted payment page, redirectToCheckout, PaymentIntent, guest checkout, save card, 托管支付页, 跳转支付, 一次性收单. Do NOT use for Billing Hosted Checkout (subscription/billing_checkouts); that's a different product.
skills.description_zh: 生成 Airwallex Hosted Payment Page 集成代码，用于 redirectToCheckout、PaymentIntent、访客结账、存卡和一次性收单；不用于订阅或 billing_checkouts 所属 Billing Hosted Checkout。

skills.name: airwallex-kyc
skills.description: Generate Airwallex Connected Account KYC onboarding integration code. Use when user mentions KYC, embedded KYC element, createElement('kyc'), hosted KYC flow, connected account onboarding, 开户认证, 连接账户. Do NOT use for payment collection flows (HPP, Drop-in, Split Card); those are separate payment integration skills.
skills.description_zh: 生成 Airwallex Connected Account KYC 开户认证集成代码，支持嵌入式 kyc 元素和托管流程；不用于 HPP、Drop-in 或 Split Card 收款集成。

skills.name: airwallex-split-card
skills.description: Generate Airwallex Split Card Element integration code. Use when user mentions Split Card, cardNumber element, expiry/cvc element, individual card inputs, custom card form, 拆分卡元素, or 自定义卡输入. Do NOT use for Drop-in (multi-method) or HPP (redirect) flows.
skills.description_zh: 生成 Airwallex Split Card Element 集成代码，用独立卡号、有效期和 CVC 元素建立自定义卡表单；不用于多方式 Drop-in 或跳转 HPP。
